body:
## Pull request overview

Adds planning documentation to evaluate and outline an authentication approach for the Console using `@objectstack/client` with `better-auth`, and updates the project roadmap to track the resulting P0 gaps and a proposed delivery timeline.

**Changes:**
- Added a new feasibility/gap-analysis plan doc for Console authentication and full login-to-usage flow.
- Updated `ROADMAP.md` with an “Authentication & Console Gaps (P0)” section and a Q1 “Console Authentication System” initiative, plus cross-references into Q2 System Objects work.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| ROADMAP.md | Adds auth-related P0 gaps and a 6-week phased plan; updates Q2 system objects section to reference Q1 groundwork; links the new plan doc. |
| CONSOLE_AUTH_PLAN.md | New detailed feasibility evaluation + gap analysis + proposed `@object-ui/auth` package/API and phased implementation plan. |

This document is written primarily in Chinese, but the repo has an English-only documentation rule (see `.github/copilot-instructions.md` Rule #-1). Please translate the entire doc (headings, tables, prose) to English so it matches the rest of the codebase and is accessible to all contributors.

The roadmap lists “Internationalization: No built-in i18n support” as a current P0 gap, but this same document later states `@object-ui/i18n` is created and integrated (Q1 §1.2). Please reconcile these statements (e.g., clarify what’s still missing, or remove/update the gap) to avoid misleading status reporting.
```suggestion
- ⚠️ Internationalization: @object-ui/i18n implemented but not yet production-ready (missing docs, test coverage, and default locale management)
```
